notes: One handwritten planning-list sheet on the printed INSTITUT / DES HAUTES ÉTUDES SCIENTIFIQUES letterhead. The title SGA 7 lies inside a light loop. Four main entries are arranged as two brace groups: two upper VI-related notes, then XXI and XXII notes concerning appendices, torsion and crystalline cohomology. The second entry says la lettre Deligne 2 pages. Authorial questions are the two free question marks in the first entry (including Refaire 1.14 ?), the parenthesized (?) by XXII, and the marginal faire un exposé XXIII ?. The first numeral and top brace are retraced, but no separately readable cancelled predecessor is recoverable; no independent insertion or deletion is established. There is no date, signature, or manuscript page number. The bottom-left 76 is recorded as an archive-number comment, not as manuscript pagination. The blank lower part was inspected in half b. Processing and delivery details are in processing_metadata.json. No external source, other page, peer file, OCR, or TeX engine was used.
math_reading_decisions: The unmarked Roman targets were independently read as VI, XXI, XXII and marginal XXIII, each with both an upper and lower rule. The first crowded numeral remains VI/VII rather than being normalized from the following VI.

The dotted references 1.11, the following 1.14, 1.15 and the final Refaire 1.14 were read from their individual strokes. The first 1.14 has a left hooked member, a short joining bar and a right downward stroke forming the final 4. The endpoint after the dash remains 1.22/1.21.
The range separator is a short ordinary unheaded horizontal dash. It is not an arrow or an equality.

Two free question marks occur in the first entry, (?) has both curved parentheses in the fourth entry, and the marginal question has a detached low point. The abbreviation coh. includes its period; the final cristalline is followed by a separate full stop.
The long straight mark above the first decimal references belongs to the printed heading; it was not treated as a mathematical bar over those numbers.

The left enclosure and the two braces are grouping graphics, not cancellation or insertion connectors. Their LaTeX paths are retained in the reading, with the additional visible lower retracing of the upper brace.

completion: Complete independent reading of scan 077: whole image viewed once for layout, half a then half b once each line by line, followed by one retained enlargement for each of eleven genuinely open loci. All textual blocks, the printed letterhead and rule, SGA 7 enclosure, both braces, the slanted margin question, numeral rules, punctuation and archive number are represented. All ten explicit C doubt occurrences, every substantive witness difference and the new relation/relations uncertainty have individual decisions with whole-image bboxes. After writing, braces, environment nesting and math delimiters were checked for balance, and report fields, bboxes, taxonomy and crop references were validated. No TeX compilation was performed.
